history.summary: Freehold 4BR (1528sqft) at The Amery, a 2012 D15 development, at $3.30M / $2,160 PSF — priced ~14% above the $1,888 URA median, above the liquid band, with the worst technical score in the batch (374). The 8.4% URA rate is built on only 7 txns and cannot be trusted.
history.rating_rationale: $2,160 PSF vs $1,888 URA median is a ~14% premium, and $3.30M pushes past the liquid sweet spot into a thinner buyer pool. Score 374 / Elo 1214 is the lowest in the batch. The headline 8.43%/yr rests on just 7 transactions — statistically meaningless. Marine Terrace MRT is 1.18km (not walkable). Freehold + East Coast are genuine, but you are overpaying versus the district's own median for an aging large unit with weak liquidity signals — poor risk/reward.
red_flags: $3.3M above liquid band — thinner exit pool
catalysts: East Coast lifestyle / eventual TEL access
